other_exits: Hedger does not manage exits - it only adjusts net position to match target offset. Individual position exits are not controlled by this EA.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Lot size is computed as the difference between target hedge lots and current net position. The EA calculates total buy lots and total sell lots across all open positions, computes net exposure, and places orders of size equal to the offset needed to reach the target hedge ratio/level.

custom_logic_notes: This is a hedging utility EA, not a signal-based trading EA. It maintains a target net position by continuously calculating the offset between current long and short exposure and a desired hedge level. It scans all open positions for the symbol, sums buy and sell lots, computes the net, and places market orders to correct the imbalance. No technical indicators, no SL/TP on hedging orders, no directional bias - purely a position management tool.
python_conversion_notes: This is a hedging/position management utility, not a signal-based EA. Python conversion requires: (1) a portfolio-level position tracker that maintains running totals of long and short lots per symbol, (2) logic to compute net exposure and delta-vs-target, (3) market order execution to adjust net position. No indicator computation needed. Backtesting requires tick data since the EA runs on OnTick and may adjust positions frequently. The hedging logic itself is straightforward arithmetic, but the multi-position state management and concurrent long/short handling adds complexity. Consider using a position-book model rather than a simple signal-based backtest framework.
